plain_english_revision: This amendment changes how money from a new sales tax in Mobile County is shared. It requires that specific amounts ($500,000 for the City of Mobile and $200,000 for other municipalities) plus an unspecified amount from the county be sent to the local Circuit Court instead of being kept entirely by those entities.
candidate_position_supported: The amendment advances a policy that redirects specific portions of sales tax proceeds from Mobile County municipalities to the local Circuit Court over a five-year period (2020–2024), while retaining the remainder for those entities.
evidence_quotes: (a) Five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000) of the proceeds distributed to the City of Mobile shall be redistributed to the Circuit Court of the Thirteenth Judicial Circuit...
...Two hundred thousand dollars ($200,000) of the proceeds distributed to the municipalities in Mobile County... shall be redistributed to the Circuit Court...
